audit_items.proof_trace: The assumption holds: `PackageCallerCap` creation is exclusively gated by `AdminCap` via `mint_new_whitelist` (the only call site of `public(package) mint_cap`), and liquidation permission bits can only be granted via `update_permission`, which also requires `AdminCap`.
